title: Spiral fill
prompt:
Fill a `rows x cols` grid counting from 1 in **spiral order**: top row left→right, right column top→bottom, bottom row right→left, left column bottom→top, then shrink inward. Implement `fill(int rows, int cols)` returning the grid.

Example: 3×4 → `{{1,2,3,4},{10,11,12,5},{9,8,7,6}}`.

tests.name: spiral order
tests.hint: Four shrinking walls (top/bottom/left/right) with re-checks before the bottom row and left column passes.
